from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmission(BaseModel):
    """One university's admission data for a specific cohort from CDS report"""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    cohort_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of cohort: 'first_year' or 'transfer'")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Total number of applicants for this cohort")
    admitted: int | None = Field(description="Total number of admitted students for this cohort")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The admission cycle/period covered in the report (e.g., Fall 2021)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_admissions: list[UniversityAdmission]
